answer: What keeps a cheat out is not a wall but a page that remembers. Maltster floor record with maltsters attestation is the page that remembers: nine-year record, 2,000 quarters malted, barley accounts, yearly fees. Enter a false saffron and both books are opened, the cheat pays the wages of a full season twice over and the umber is handed to the parish chest, while the wander is kept on file and shown to the next court.
